title: Formalisme algébrique des correspondances et algèbres de Poincaré-Hodge (cf conjectures standard) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), lettres (1966-1967).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not part of the correspondences / standard-conjectures material. It is a stray typescript page of EGA IV (numbered IV-977-12, chapter 18, §18.11), with corrections and a marginal comment, filed among the 1966-67 notes. The previous page is a manuscript note on Lefschetz-type conditions C(X), A^0(X×Y). The next is the letter to Coates of 4.1.67.

Setting. A is a complete noetherian local k-algebra with maximal ideal m and residue field K, and p is a prime of A. Proposition (18.11.5) asserts the following, under a hypothesis a) and the existence of a minimal prime q ⊂ p with dim(A/q) = dim(A). There is a local k-homomorphism u : B = k[[T_1..T_m]] → A making A a finite B-algebra, with Spec(A) → Spec(B) unramified at p. This is a Cohen/Noether-normalisation-type statement 'with unramifiedness at a given prime'.

The page is a remark on the necessity of the hypotheses.

(i) Case p = m. For any finite local u : k[[T_1..T_r]] → A, m is the only point over the maximal ideal n. By (17.4.1), unramifiedness at m forces A/nA to be a field separable over k. Hence K/k must be separable. If K/k is inseparable, the conclusion of (18.11.5) fails at p = m for every m.

(ii) Case p ≠ m, with no minimal prime q ⊂ p satisfying dim A/q = dim A. Set J = ker(A → A_p), the elements annihilated by some s ∉ p, and A' = A/J. Then:
- J ⊂ p.
- A_p ≅ A'_{p'}, where p' = p/J.
- By (18.11.3.3) and (0,20.4.12), the map of completed differentials Ω̂^1_{A/k} ⊗ A' → Ω̂^1_{A'/k} is surjective, hence also after localisation at p, p'.
- A' → A'_{p'} is injective by construction. So every element outside p' is a non-zero-divisor, all associated (in particular all minimal) primes of A' lie in p', and the minimal primes of A' and of A'_{p'} correspond bijectively.
- Hence some minimal q' ⊂ p' has dim A'/q' = dim A', and (18.11.5) applies to (A', p').

This gives u' : k[[T_1..T_m]] → A', finite and unramified at p'. One lifts u' through A → A' to u : B → A; this is possible since B is a power-series ring and A is complete. Spec(A') → Spec(A) is a local isomorphism at p' by A_p ≅ A'_{p'} and (I,6.5.4). So Spec(A) → Spec(B) is unramified at p. Thus hypothesis a) alone still yields a local k-homomorphism B → A unramified at p; the page breaks off at this point.

Marginal comment: '(ii) semble vaseux !' ('(ii) seems muddy!'), presumably Grothendieck or Dieudonné objecting to this paragraph.
errors: In (ii) the lifted u : B → A need not make A finite over B. Here m = dim A' can be strictly smaller than dim A, so finiteness of Spec(A) → Spec(B) is lost; only unramifiedness at p survives. Unless the (cut-off) conclusion explicitly drops finiteness, this is a gap, and it plausibly explains the marginal 'vaseux'.
The surjectivity of completed differentials, invoked via (18.11.3.3)/(0,20.4.12), is stated but plays no visible role in the argument on this page.

ideas.what: Unramifiedness at the closed point of a finite map from a power-series ring forces A/nA to be a separable field extension, hence K/k separable
ideas.modern_name: Unramified local homomorphisms; residue field separability criterion

ideas.what: Reducing to A' = A/ker(A → A_p) so that all minimal primes lie in p', then applying a normalisation-with-unramifiedness theorem
ideas.modern_name: Killing p-torsion / passing to the closure of Spec A_p; Cohen-type normalisation unramified at a prime
ideas.where_published: EGA IV_4 §18.11 (exact published form of this remark unverified)

missed.claim: Archival only: a draft page of EGA IV §18.11 with a critical marginal note is misfiled in the cote devoted to correspondences and the standard conjectures. Its mathematics is routine commutative algebra and not new.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Only of interest for reconstructing the editing history of EGA IV_4 (1967), not mathematically.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine EGA IV draft remark (necessity of hypotheses in 18.11.5) with a small gap: finiteness is lost in case (ii). It is misfiled and unrelated to the standard conjectures; nothing new.
transcription_corrections: Page header reads '- IV- 977 - 12 -' (handwritten 977), i.e. an EGA IV typescript page.
Reference is (18.11.3.3), with the final digit overwritten by hand; '(0,20.4.12)' has the 0 underlined in red.
Handwritten insertion: 'relative à l'existence de l'idéal minimal q'.
Handwritten 'premiers' inserted before 'minimaux', and 'par suite' replacing the struck word.
Handwritten 'Spec(A) → Spec(B)' above the struck-out text, and 'f' :' inserted before Spec(A') → Spec(B).
Marginal note reads roughly 'Vider (?) / (ii) semble / vaseux !'; the number 42 is the archive page number.
In '(I,6.5.4)' the I is underlined in red.
